description.value: A worked channel block of gallery stone, half a metre long, cut to divert warm vent flow across a mat bed and hold it within about a degree. Blocks are set in series and adjusted by hand over months, and a chorus tending a bed forty kilometres from the body doing the adjusting is the ordinary case, so the block carries no trace of any individual hand, there being no such category here. This example was pulled after a gallery shifted and was left at a mouth for collection, with the position it had held stated on the tally beside it. It is heavily mineralised on the upstream face and clean on the other, which is the whole of the diagnostic.
